name: OKM Lobo Admin – Dashboard Customizer
author: okmultimedia

sections.description:
Lobo Admin gives the WordPress admin area a calm, clean look in one click.

  • White dashboard with dark blue text, in the side menu, the toolbar, tables and buttons.
  • Outlined icons in the side menu instead of the default filled ones.
  • The WordPress logo removed from the toolbar.
  • The WordPress logo removed from the login screen.

Each change has its own switch, so you keep only what you want.

Lobo Admin Pro

The paid version, available at okmultimedia.com, adds:

  • Twelve ready-made color palettes and your own colors, with text that always stays readable.
  • Your own logo in the dashboard and on the login screen.
  • A custom login screen: logo, background and button color.
  • Notices hidden for the roles you choose.
  • Menu entries hidden for the roles you choose.
  • No “Lobo Admin by OK Multimedia” credit, or your own footer text.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it.
  2. Open “Lobo Admin” in the side menu to switch each change on or off.
sections.faq:
Does it change anything on the public site?

Only the toolbar shown to logged-in users. Visitors see no difference.

Can I go back to the WordPress look?

Yes. Switch “White dashboard” off, or deactivate the plugin.
